name: omarchy-listening-post
description: Listening Post widget for the Omarchy bar - node is used ONLY to run the offline unit suite; the shipped plugin requires no node runtime

scripts.test: npm run test:plugin && npm run test:contract
scripts.test:product: npm test && npm --prefix web test && npm --prefix api test
scripts.build:product: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.test:race: for run in 1 2 3; do node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/*.test.js || exit; done
scripts.audit: audit-harness verify && audit-harness audit . --deep && audit-harness scan .
